definition: I. [ חָלַם ] verb be healthy, strong (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic Ethpe`el be made healthy, strong , Aph`el causative, also derivatives; חֲלַם press firmly together ) — Qal Imperfect יַחְלְמוּ בְנֵיהֶם Job 39:4 their young are healthy. Hiph`il Imperfect 2 masculine singular וְתַחֲלִימֵנִי Isa 38:16 and restore me to health (|| וְהַחֲיֵ֫ינִי ).
